reviews.text: The pores on my T-zone have definitely gotten finer and smoother. As for the firming effect, it’s not as dramatic as people online say—you can tell my skin looks a bit more plump and full. Collagen and peptides mainly need long-term use to actually give you firming results.
reviews.zh: 我嘅 T 字部位毛孔肯定變得更細、更滑。至於緊緻效果，就冇網上人講嗰樣誇張，你睇得出我皮膚睇落飽滿咗少少。膠原蛋白同胜肽主要需要長期使用，先真正有緊緻效果。

reviews.text:
I wasn’t sure about this at first, packaging is lovely, bottle and no smell and great texture. 
I wasn’t sure it was reducing my pore or giving a glow but when I stopped using I did notice a difference so I’m going to continue as it must be working! 
I pair with Anua pdrn moisturiser and use once a day
reviews.zh:
一開始我唔太肯定，包裝好靚，樽裝，冇味道，質地好好。
我唔肯定佢有冇減少毛孔或者帶嚟光澤，但係當我停用咗之後，我真係覺得有分別，所以我會繼續用，因為佢一定有效！
我配搭 Anua PDRN 保濕霜，每日用一次。

reviews.text: A serum that absorbs quickly, improves skin texture, leaves it smooth, velvety, with a plumper and firmer appearance. I have normal skin, without enlarged pores, so I can't say that I use it for this kind of problem, but I like the suppleness it confers to the skin, the hydration, calming, and the healthy appearance it leaves.
reviews.zh: 一款吸收好快嘅精華，改善皮膚質地，令皮膚滑順、絲絨般柔軟，外觀更加飽滿、緊緻。我嘅皮膚係中性，冇擴大嘅毛孔，所以我唔能夠話我係為咗呢類問題而用。不過我鍾意佢帶俾皮膚嘅柔韌感、保濕、舒緩，以及留低嘅健康外觀。

reviews.text: My skin texture improved but it didn’t do anything for my pores 🥺
reviews.zh: 皮膚質地有改善，但係對毛孔冇咩幫助 🥺

reviews.text: I just started using this, so I’m not sure if it’s improving my pores yet. But I can already say it’s super lightweight and absorbs quickly. Plus, the bottle is pink… that alone gets 10 points! 😉
reviews.zh: 我啱啱開始用，所以未確定佢有冇改善毛孔。但係我已經可以講，佢超級輕盈，吸收好快。另外，樽係粉紅色嘅……單係呢一點已經加十分！😉

reviews.text: I love this product and I think it is very under hyped. You can see the results in just a few days works very well in to make up absorbs beautifully into the skin and very hydrating. Very recommended.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款產品，我覺得佢被低估咗。幾日內就見到效果，同化妝配合得好好，又能夠好漂亮咁吸收入皮膚，保濕效果都好好。非常推薦。

reviews.text: The texture is thick and a bit sticky, but it’s very hydrating without being oily. It absorbs into the skin quickly and doesn't cause any redness on my sensitive skin. I'm so happy with it! I’ve almost finished the whole bottle and will definitely repurchase.
reviews.zh: 質地濃稠，有少少黏，但係保濕效果好好，又唔會油膩。吸收入皮膚好快，對我嘅敏感皮膚都唔會引致任何泛紅。我好滿意！我差唔多用晒成支，一定會再買。

reviews.text: The dropper is hard to use, it picks up very minimal serum each time so I have been having to picknup serum 2 times every time I use it, which is a hassle when I'm rushing in the morning. Have been using it for a week but haven't noticed much difference just yet.
reviews.zh: 滴管好難用，每次只可以吸到好少精華，所以我每次都要吸兩次，早上趕時間嗰陣好麻煩。用咗一個禮拜，但係暫時都未見到好大分別。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
